scenario: a misunderstanding or problem involving hotels & accommodation
english_title: Recognising and Responding to a Misunderstanding or Problem Involving Hotels and Accommodation
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: hotels & accommodation — a misunderstanding or problem involving hotels & accommodation
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to a misunderstanding or problem involving hotels & accommodation; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Lan tells Mr James her room is not ready yet.
context_note_vi: Chị Lan nói với anh James phòng của mình chưa sẵn sàng.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Excuse me, James. My room is not ready yet.
turns.vietnamese: Xin lỗi anh James. Phòng của tôi chưa sẵn sàng.

turns.speaker: Mr James
turns.english: I am sorry. It will be ready in ten minutes.
turns.vietnamese: Tôi xin lỗi. Phòng sẽ sẵn sàng trong mười phút nữa.

turns.speaker: Mr James
turns.vietnamese: Cảm ơn chị đã kiên nhẫn chờ.
